reason: I have no budget this year unless something pays back fast, and a $2,000 a month tool from a startup that hasn't built the product yet doesn't pay back on a sales pitch. I might take the free six-week test with a few exports, but I wouldn't approve the paid pilot without seeing it catch real late POs first.
objection: Will it catch the late supplier dates and short shipments before they become premium freight and blown work orders, or will it just give me a list I have to check by hand every morning?
would_change_my_mind: The free six-week test flags at-risk work orders that my team had not already caught, with a payback number I can show my plant manager.
